operations: Read-only account/catalog/configuration; no model or indexing dispatch

steps.title: Read the document (OCR)
steps.summary: Reads the text of the startup files or of the files of the linked sources.

steps.title: Ask an agent
steps.summary: Asks an agent of the application, optionally with an output structure.

steps.title: Call an endpoint (API)
steps.summary: Sends the data to a catalog webhook or makes a custom HTTP call.

steps.title: Send an email
steps.summary: Sends an email with templates and, optionally, the files of the linked sources.

steps.title: Merge results
steps.summary: Combines JSON data, also from several linked sources.

steps.title: Create a file
steps.summary: Turns the JSON input into a CSV or JSON file for the delivery steps.

steps.title: Send on WhatsApp
steps.summary: Sends a text or an approved template from a WhatsApp number of the application.

steps.title: Process with AI
steps.summary: Calls a model inline with a system prompt and an optional output structure.

steps.title: Choice (if… else)
steps.summary: Activates the true or false branch with rules, a script, an AI prompt or a typed decision.

steps.title: Repeat for each item
steps.summary: Runs the loop body once per item of a list, or once per document.

steps.title: Task for the digital employee
steps.summary: Creates a task for a digital employee and goes on.

steps.title: Start another automation
steps.summary: Runs another workflow of the same application.

steps.title: Routing
steps.summary: Activates the branch of one case, or the default branch.

steps.title: Call a data extractor
steps.summary: Extracts data from the documents with a data extractor and its schema.

steps.title: Automation output
steps.summary: Declares the result of the automation.

steps.title: Call a number
steps.summary: Calls a number with an AI switchboard of the application.

steps.title: AI Tool
steps.summary: Runs one of the AI Tools of the platform catalog on text or documents.

steps.title: Anonymize data
steps.summary: Replaces personal data with surrogates that RestoreData can reverse.

steps.title: Restore data
steps.summary: Puts back the real values replaced by an AnonymizeData step.

steps.title: Run a script
steps.summary: Transforms the data with deterministic JavaScript.

steps.title: Decision
steps.summary: Asks a decision model one or more typed questions and outputs the answers with their probabilities.
